title: Texas Instruments reports Q1 revenue up 19% YoY to $4.83B, vs. $4.52B est., and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates; TXN jumps 8%+ after hours (Ian King/Bloomberg)
summary: Ian King / Bloomberg: Texas Instruments reports Q1 revenue up 19% YoY to $4.83B, vs. $4.52B est., and forecasts Q2 revenue above estimates; TXN jumps 8%+ after hours — Texas Instruments Inc., the biggest producer of analog chips, gave a surprisingly strong forecast for the current period, helped by booming spending on data centers.
